fields.description:
**Related:** WAGR-44

**Summary:** At the Sep 25 call, we agreed that BA commissions stay outside Salesforce at launch. Salesforce supplies the data, and Jay's tool calculates the commissions. Rippling is the later target. Nobody has defined what data Salesforce must supply.

**Requirements captured**

* Pay streams that the data must support: BA weekly pay; a manager's % of the team; flat rate, or a rate for one rep's specific deal based on volume; manager pay by rep count; US manager pay (monthly); B2C rep pay.
* The data must include the manager and team structure.

**Open questions:** Which fields, at what grain (Sign-Up, BA or week), how often, in what format, and pushed or pulled? Is the commission matrix by market or by deal? _(Lina still owes the matrix.)_ How does BA-level currency affect payouts (Emily, Aug 27)?

**Done when:** the export specification is agreed with Emily and Jay, and one build story exists.

**Sources (traceable):**

* Referral and Payouts discovery, 2026-09-25 (scope: commissions outside SF) — https://fathom.video/calls/835861150
* Weekly sync, 2026-09-01 (commission matrix grain) — https://fathom.video/calls/804141114
* Emily, Slack 2026-08-27 (BA-level currency nuance) — https://jumpr-solutions.slack.com/archives/C0BBC05C2HG/p1787855202988159
* Currency sync, 2026-08-27 — https://fathom.video/calls/801560089

---

_Captured 2026-09-25 by Kobi from the WagerTech calls, Slack, Jira and sandbox review (Jul–Sep 2026). Design backlog item: requirements only, not a solution._
